objectDescription: Demo users of the Demo Factory, in the app table demo_factory_demo_users: the accounts Playwright signs in as in the target applications (a demo picks one in settings.demoUser). One row per user: id, label, the application it is meant for. The user's API key is never in this table: save-demo-user writes it to the secret store (organization level, demo-factory-user-<id>), and `configured` is looked up there on every read. keyFields=id.
